title: Sports in Our Family
text:
I like sports. My favourite sport is football. I play football with my friends on Saturday. We play in the park.

My sister likes swimming. She goes to the pool every Monday. She swims for one hour. After swimming, she is very happy.

questions.text: What is the speaker's favourite sport?
How long does the sister swim?
What can we guess about the speaker's weekends?
options: The speaker often plays sport with friends

questions.text: What kind of person is the sister probably?

vocabulary.definition: a sport played by two teams kicking a ball
a large place filled with water for swimming

paragraph_translations: Sporu severim. En sevdiğim spor futboldur. Cumartesi günü arkadaşlarımla futbol oynarım. Parkta oynarız.
Kız kardeşim yüzmeyi sever. Her pazartesi havuza gider. Bir saat yüzer. Yüzmeden sonra çok mutlu olur.
